values: Hey—quick question. I built an Android app called SpotLift that scans gym equipment and explains how to use it. I need a few real gym users to test it for 14 days. Would you be open to trying it?
Awesome. I’ll send you a private Google Play test link. You accept it with the Google account on your Android phone, install the app, and try a few gym flows over the next two weeks.
Here’s the private SpotLift Android beta link: [PASTE OPT-IN LINK]. Open it with the same Google account used in your Play Store, tap Become a tester, then install SpotLift.
How did SpotLift do with the equipment you tried? If anything was confusing or slow, send me one sentence or a screenshot.
Thanks again for testing SpotLift. Please stay opted in through [DAY-14 DATE]. Is there one feature you’d keep, change, or remove?
You made it through the full beta—thank you. Your testing directly helps SpotLift qualify for the Play Store launch.
1) Open opt-in link  2) Become a tester  3) Install from Play Store  4) Scan one machine  5) Search one exercise  6) Try Coach  7) Stay opted in 14 days
Use tester contact information only for this closed test and normal SpotLift follow-up. Do not share the list.
Recruit 15 people to safely maintain the required 12 active testers.
Regular gym members, trainers, friends, students, or family members who own Android devices and will genuinely install and try the app.
